chunks: They had nearly expelled you from the land and driven you away from it. But then, they too would have stayed but a little after you.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the duration of the enemies' rule if they had expelled the Prophet?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine protection of the Prophet (SAWW) during the critical Meccan period, where the Quraysh's attempts to displace him ultimately failed due to their own internal fragility. The phrase 'short-lived' serves as a prophetic indicator of the transient nature of polytheistic power compared to the enduring legacy of the Ahl al-Bayt and the eventual triumph of Islam.
